original_native_abi.ghidra_convention_note: The decompiler prototype displays an IMessageManager return; the raw PUSH ESI, RET 0x4 sequence proves the returned EAX is the stack result pointer.

mechanics: zero result words at offsets 0x00, 0x04, and 0x08
call the receiver vtable slot at +0x20 with ECX still equal to the Canvas receiver
on a true probe, copy the three words from 0x01579eb0, 0x01579eb4, and 0x01579eb8
on a false probe, read the property-list pointer at receiver+0x30 and call 0x006a1250 with property id 0xa6a37fc4 and the result as the destination
on a successful fallback lookup, write 0x00b1b104 to result+0x04 and 0x05f4d5e7 to result+0x08
return the result pointer in EAX
body.fallback_destination: result pointer is the third stack argument to 0x006a1250; its first word remains the successful property-key instance value

live_evidence.global_xrefs: 0x01579eb0, 0x01579eb4, and 0x01579eb8 each have one read reference from this body
